question: In a certain code language, if NATURE is coded as 'MASUQE', CIRCLE is coded as 'BIQCKE', then what will 'DANGER' be coded as?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8917e7e4a037fb946fafa0b16de664d6f0ce32ab76e5c2c9b848dc1f771a7f81.png] 

The logic followed here is:

NATURE is coded as 'MASUQE',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7311ba97ca06b401467e86d9ba986f675b763d6cddb5bebec3d1f925d8889657.png] 

CIRCLE is coded as 'BIQCKE',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/123606087b0175150546c3465f5ea92acf5871c2d54bcde3cc991a24f81e3e6d.png] 

Similarly, 'DANGER' will be coded:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0315e2007bfe971c2f9b67e856d37e2635bb6b5ded87427822a0e77da577181a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**CAMGDR**".
